record_title: Odd-squarefree hardness for Dense Pinwheel Packing
provenance: An arithmetic restriction of the unary NP-completeness reduction for Dense Pinwheel Packing in Kobayashi--Lin--Swernofsky, arXiv:2609.20075v1, obtained by prime-padding the sparse tripartite source instance before applying the marker-prime construction.
limitations: Equal periods remain allowed as distinct tasks. The result does not address distinct-modulus exact covering systems and does not prove that five prime factors per period is optimal. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with elevated near-simultaneous priority risk because arXiv:2609.20075v1 is very recent and the prime-padding refinement is short once its reduction is known.
